raw_text: THREAD: New satellite imagery from Pangong Tso reveals significant PLA construction activity near Finger 8. What appears to be a permanent bridge structure is being built across a narrow section of the lake. This was not present in imagery from December 2023. Foundation pillars clearly visible. This represents a significant change in Chinese infrastructure posture along the LAC. Indian forces will need to respond to this fait accompli approach to border infrastructure. Tagging @IAaboron @IndianDGMO for awareness.
